requirement: The Android SDK shall schedule submitted work and upload requests asynchronously on a background thread to reduce blocking of the host application's main thread. It shall also support dispatching component work to the main thread when required.

The SDK shall process queued upload files only when network connectivity is available. For a forced-send request, it shall retrieve pending locally stored data before scanning upload files. Each file's contents shall be sent together with Android-context-derived information through the configured sender. Successfully sent files shall be deleted; failed uploads shall be logged and their files retained.

The SDK shall monitor Apache HttpClient responses in association with their transaction state and apply response instrumentation before invoking the application's existing response handler. It shall count bytes read from instrumented response bodies while preserving compatible content access and output writing.
